title: Opening overture pigeons
creator: Chunk Surfer procedural authoring
description: Original hero rock pigeon geometry: smoothly rounded breast, small slate head, orange-red iris and pupil within orbital rim, split dark bill with ivory cere and nostrils, green-purple neck feathers, white rump, twelve tail feathers with dark terminal band, two wing bars, layered coverts and ten solid primary feathers per wing, scaly red legs and individual clawed toes. Chipped ivory L-corners and short dashed sides mark a2.8m by6.2m service parking bay. No external images or meshes.
